paragraphs.ko: 공격력과 속도만 다르면, 캐릭터의 플레이 방식도 달라질까요?
paragraphs.en: Does changing attack power and speed automatically change how a character plays?

paragraphs.ko: 라이벌즈 오브 이더의 대전과 고유 기술을 보고, 던전스 오브 이더의 능력치와 자원 변화를 비교하겠습니다.
paragraphs.en: We will examine combat and distinctive abilities in Rivals of Aether, then compare changes to stats and resources in Dungeons of Aether.

paragraphs.ko: 먼저 공통 동작에서 출발해, 강점과 약점이 어떤 선택을 만드는지 정리해 보죠.
paragraphs.en: Starting with shared actions, we will work out what choices a character’s strengths and limitations create.

paragraphs.ko: 이 대전에서는 두 캐릭터 모두 움직이고, 뛰고, 공격하며 발판을 오갑니다. 같은 게임을 한다는 공통 기준이 먼저 보이죠.
paragraphs.en: Both fighters move, jump, attack and travel between platforms. Their actions first establish that they are playing the same game.

paragraphs.ko: 이 기준 없이 모든 수치를 따로 정하면, 차이가 얼마나 큰지 비교하기도 어렵습니다. 먼저 누구나 할 수 있는 행동과 필요한 최소 성능을 정해 보세요.
paragraphs.en: If every value is chosen independently, even the size of a difference becomes hard to judge. Begin with shared actions and the minimum performance needed to use them.

paragraphs.ko: 그다음 차이를 넣어야 합니다. 똑같은 공격 버튼을 눌러도 어느 거리에서 기회를 만들고, 어디로 이동하는지가 달라지는지 살펴보는 거죠.
paragraphs.en: Then introduce differences. With the same attack button available, look at where each character creates an opportunity and where they choose to move.

paragraphs.ko: 공식 플레이 장면에는 상대에게 남는 불 효과, 물과 거품, 연기처럼 서로 다른 현상이 등장합니다. 공격력을 조금씩 바꾸는 것과는 다른 차이죠.
paragraphs.en: Official gameplay shows different phenomena: fire persisting on an opponent, water and bubbles, and smoke. These differences go beyond small changes to attack power.

paragraphs.ko: 라이벌즈 오브 이더의 제터번과 오르케인을 보세요. 불이 붙은 상대를 보는 일과 물이 생긴 위치를 보는 일은, 플레이어가 주목할 정보를 다르게 만듭니다.
paragraphs.en: Look at Zetterburn and Orcane in Rivals of Aether. Watching a burning opponent and watching the location of water direct the player’s attention to different information.

paragraphs.ko: 고유 규칙을 설계할 때는 무엇이 달라지는지 먼저 쓰세요. 상대의 상태인지, 공간인지, 사용할 수 있는 행동인지가 분명해야 수치 조정도 의미를 갖습니다.
paragraphs.en: Before tuning a distinctive rule, name what it changes: the opponent’s state, a location or an available action. Clear rules give numerical tuning a purpose.

paragraphs.ko: 포스번 장면에는 닮은 두 형체가 보이고, 뒤이어 연기가 인물을 가립니다. 상대가 어디를 보고 판단해야 하는지가 달라지는 예시입니다.
paragraphs.en: Forsburn’s footage shows two similar figures, followed by smoke obscuring the fighters. It changes where an opponent must look to make a decision.

paragraphs.ko: 이런 차이는 피해량 표 하나로 설명하기 어렵습니다. 공격이 강한지뿐 아니라 상대에게 어떤 판단을 요구하는지를 살펴봐야 하죠.
paragraphs.en: A damage table alone cannot describe this difference. Ask not only how strong an attack is, but also what judgment it demands from the opponent.

paragraphs.ko: 다만 연기가 있다는 사실만으로 무적이라고 말할 수는 없습니다. 효과의 겉모습, 실제 판정, 상대가 대응할 방법은 나눠서 설계하고 확인해야 합니다.
paragraphs.en: Smoke does not by itself prove invulnerability. Design and verify the appearance, actual interaction rules and available responses separately.

paragraphs.ko: 다시 대전을 보면 두 캐릭터가 지상과 공중, 발판 바깥을 오갑니다. 같은 기술도 서로 떨어진 거리와 현재 위치에 따라 쓰일 기회가 달라지죠.
paragraphs.en: The fighters travel across the ground, through the air and beyond the platform edge. Distance and position change the opportunities to use an ability.

paragraphs.ko: 강점은 수치가 큰 항목이라는 설명에서 끝나면 부족합니다. 어떤 상황에서 유리한 선택을 만들고, 그 상황에 어떻게 들어가는지까지 연결해 보세요.
paragraphs.en: A strength needs more than a large number in a table. Connect it to an advantageous choice and to the means of reaching that situation.

paragraphs.ko: 예를 들어 가까이 붙어 압박하는 역할을 설계한다면, 접근 방법과 공격 뒤의 선택이 함께 필요합니다. 공격력만 올리고 접근할 수 없게 만들면 그 강점을 사용하기 어렵습니다.
paragraphs.en: For a hypothetical close-pressure role, approach tools and choices after an attack belong together. Raising damage without any way to get close can leave that strength unusable.

paragraphs.ko: 강점을 넣었다면 약점도 생각해야 합니다. 하지만 모든 능력을 낮춰 아무것도 할 수 없게 만드는 것은 개성 있는 약점과 다릅니다.
paragraphs.en: Once a strength exists, consider its limitations. Reducing every ability until nothing works is different from giving a character a distinctive weakness.

paragraphs.ko: 화면처럼 위치가 계속 바뀌는 게임에서는, 불리한 거리에서 빠져나오거나 자신이 잘하는 거리로 돌아갈 선택이 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.en: In a game with constantly changing positions, check whether a character can leave an unfavorable distance or return to a range where their tools are useful.

paragraphs.ko: 상대에게도 대응을 남겨 주세요. 유리한 상황을 만들기 위한 준비가 보이고, 실패했을 때 빈틈이 생기면 강점과 약점이 하나의 플레이 방식으로 연결됩니다.
paragraphs.en: Keep responses available to the opponent too. Readable preparation and openings after failure connect strengths and limitations into a coherent playstyle.

paragraphs.ko: 플레이어 캐릭터와 적의 역할도 구분해 보세요. 설계 예시로, 단순히 돌진하는 적도 좁은 통로에 배치하거나 다른 적과 조합하면 다른 대응을 요구할 수 있습니다. 배치의 효과는 실제 플레이테스트로 확인해야 합니다.
paragraphs.en: Distinguish a playable character’s role from an enemy’s role too. In a hypothetical design, even a simple charging enemy can demand a different response in a narrow corridor or in combination with another enemy. Verify the placement’s effect through actual playtests.

paragraphs.ko: 경기 아래쪽의 퍼센트는 공격력 표가 아닙니다. 맞으면서 바뀌는 현재 피해 상태이고, 남은 목숨 수도 별도로 표시됩니다.
paragraphs.en: The percentages at the bottom are not an attack-power table. They show current damage state, while remaining stocks are displayed separately.

paragraphs.ko: 캐릭터를 비교할 때는 기본 성능, 지금 걸린 효과, 플레이어의 판단을 구분해야 합니다. 한 순간의 높은 퍼센트만으로 그 캐릭터가 더 강하다고 판단하면 이유를 뒤섞게 됩니다.
paragraphs.en: Separate base capabilities, active effects and player decisions when comparing characters. A high percentage in one moment cannot establish which character is stronger.

paragraphs.ko: 이 자료는 과거 경기입니다. 여기서는 실제 행동과 상태의 차이를 관찰하며, 지금의 캐릭터 순위나 보편적인 피해 배율을 계산하는 근거로 쓰지 않습니다.
paragraphs.en: This is historical match footage. We use it to observe actions and states, not to derive current character rankings or universal damage multipliers.

paragraphs.ko: 던전스 오브 이더에서는 주사위와 기술이 전투 중 수치를 바꿉니다. 하미르의 리액트 장면은 방어 값이 바뀐 뒤 상대의 공격이 막히는 흐름을 보여 줍니다.
paragraphs.en: Dice and abilities change combat values in Dungeons of Aether. Hamir’s REACT sequence shows a defense change followed by a blocked enemy attack.

paragraphs.ko: 슬레이드의 스틸은 맞힌 뒤 동전이 늘고, 아르테미스의 스턴은 상대의 주사위 상태에 영향을 줍니다. 서로 다른 장면이므로 하나의 연속 전투로 연결해서 읽지는 마세요.
paragraphs.en: Slade’s STEAL increases coins after connecting, while Artemis’s STUN affects the opponent’s dice state. These are separate shots, not one continuous battle.

paragraphs.ko: 기술의 개성은 피해량에만 있지 않습니다. 방어, 자원, 상대의 선택지를 바꾸는 효과도 역할을 만들 수 있습니다. 이때 화면의 주사위 값은 이번 턴에 쓰는 상태이며, 캐릭터에게 고정된 기본 능력치가 아닙니다.
paragraphs.en: An ability’s identity is not limited to damage. Defense, resources and the opponent’s options can also define a role. The displayed dice values are used in the current turn; they are not the character’s fixed base capabilities.

paragraphs.ko: 플릿의 스나이프 설명은 공격이 맞으면 피해를 주고, 다음 턴에 스태미나 주사위 두 개를 준다고 말합니다. 지금 스태미나가 즉시 여섯 늘었다는 뜻은 아닙니다.
paragraphs.en: Fleet’s SNIPE description says that connecting deals damage and grants two stamina dice on the next turn. It does not mean six stamina is added immediately to the current value.

paragraphs.ko: 다른 보스 장면의 스트라이크는 공격에 맞춰 하트가 줄어드는 모습을 보여 줍니다. 같은 공격 효과처럼 보여도 무엇을 언제 바꾸는지는 따로 읽어야 하죠.
paragraphs.en: STRIKE in a separate boss shot shows a heart decreasing with the hit. Similar-looking attack effects still need separate descriptions of what changes and when.

paragraphs.ko: 설계 문장에도 발동 조건, 바뀌는 대상, 적용 시점을 함께 적어 보세요. 그래야 실제 프로그램의 동작과 화면 설명이 서로 다른 규칙을 말하는 일을 줄일 수 있습니다.
paragraphs.en: Write the trigger, affected target and application time together. This helps the program’s actual behavior and the on-screen explanation describe the same rule.

paragraphs.ko: 차이가 있다고 해서 모든 조합이 공정해지는 것은 아닙니다. 반대로 모든 성능을 평균으로 맞춘다고 재미있는 차이가 남는 것도 아니죠.
paragraphs.en: Differences alone do not make every combination fair. Making every capability average does not automatically preserve interesting distinctions either.

paragraphs.ko: 특정 상대나 장소에서 아무 대응도 못 하는지, 준비 없이 모든 상황을 해결하는지부터 확인해 보세요. 한 경기의 승패만 보고 전체 밸런스를 확정하지 말고 조건을 나눠 반복해서 검토해야 합니다.
paragraphs.en: Check for opponents or locations with no workable response, and for tools that solve every situation without preparation. Review conditions across repeated tests rather than declaring balance from one match.

paragraphs.ko: 문제가 있는 조건과 수치를 고치되, 그 캐릭터가 무엇을 잘하는지는 남기는 겁니다. 조정 뒤에도 같은 역할을 한 문장으로 설명할 수 있는지 확인해 보세요.
paragraphs.en: Repair problematic conditions and values while preserving what the character does well. After a change, check whether the role still fits the same concise description.

paragraphs.ko: 고유 규칙이 늘면 확인할 조합도 늘어납니다. 효과가 끝나는 순간, 다음 턴으로 넘어가는 순간, 다른 기술과 만나는 순간을 함께 다뤄야 합니다.
paragraphs.en: More unique rules create more combinations to verify: an effect ending, a turn changing and an interaction with another ability.

paragraphs.ko: 불, 물, 연기처럼 구별되는 현상을 넣을 때도, 처음부터 예외를 끝없이 붙이기보다는 핵심 규칙을 짧게 정리해 보세요. 필요한 상태와 전환이 드러나면 테스트할 질문도 구체적이 됩니다.
paragraphs.en: When adding distinct phenomena such as fire, water or smoke, begin with a concise core rule rather than an endless list of exceptions. Explicit states and transitions make test questions more concrete.

paragraphs.ko: 이 캐릭터는 어떤 상황에서 무엇으로 유리해지고, 상대는 어떻게 대응할 수 있는가. 이 문장을 팀원에게 설명할 수 있어야 기술과 능력치가 같은 방향으로 발전합니다.
paragraphs.en: In what situation does this character gain an advantage, through what tool, and how can an opponent respond? A shared answer keeps abilities and numerical tuning moving in the same direction.

paragraphs.ko: 캐릭터의 개성은 숫자의 차이를 플레이어의 선택으로 연결할 때 선명해집니다. 공통 기준 위에 강점과 약점, 고유 규칙을 함께 놓아 보세요.
paragraphs.en: A character’s identity becomes clear when numerical differences create different player choices. Build strengths, limitations and distinctive rules on a shared baseline.

paragraphs.ko: 기본 성능과 현재 상태를 구분하고, 효과의 조건과 시점을 정확히 적어 주세요. 쓸 수 없는 약점이나 모든 상황을 지배하는 강점은 고치면서도 역할은 남기는 겁니다.
paragraphs.en: Separate base capabilities from current state, and specify the conditions and timing of effects. Repair unusable weaknesses or universally dominant strengths while keeping the role intact.

paragraphs.ko: 다음 캐릭터를 만들 때는 능력치 표부터 채우기 전에, 어떤 상황에서 어떤 선택으로 기억될지 한 문장으로 적어 보세요.
paragraphs.en: Before filling out the next character’s stat table, write one sentence about the situation and choice you want players to remember.

old: Does changing attack power and speed automatically change how a character
plays?
new: Does changing attack power and speed
automatically change how a character plays?

old: We will examine combat and distinctive abilities in Rivals of Aether, then
compare changes to stats and resources in Dungeons of Aether.
new: We will examine combat and distinctive abilities in Rivals of Aether,
then compare changes to stats and resources in Dungeons of Aether.

old: Starting with shared actions, we will work out what choices a character’s
strengths and limitations create.
new: Starting with shared actions, we will work out what
choices a character’s strengths and limitations create.

old: Both fighters move, jump, attack and travel between platforms. Their actions
first establish that they are playing the same game.
new: Both fighters move, jump, attack and travel between platforms.
Their actions first establish that they are playing the same game.

old: If every value is chosen independently, even the size of a difference becomes
hard to judge. Begin with shared actions and the minimum performance needed to
use them.
new: If every value is chosen independently, even the size
of a difference becomes hard to judge. Begin with shared
actions and the minimum performance needed to use them.

old: Then introduce differences. With the same attack button available, look at
where each character creates an opportunity and where they choose to move.
new: Then introduce differences. With the same attack button available, look at
where each character creates an opportunity and where they choose to move.

old: Official gameplay shows different phenomena: fire persisting on an opponent,
water and bubbles, and smoke. These differences go beyond small changes to
attack power.
new: Official gameplay shows different phenomena: fire
persisting on an opponent, water and bubbles, and smoke.
These differences go beyond small changes to attack power.

old: Look at Zetterburn and Orcane in Rivals of Aether. Watching a burning opponent
and watching the location of water direct the player’s attention to different
information.
new: Look at Zetterburn and Orcane in Rivals of Aether.
Watching a burning opponent and watching the location of
water direct the player’s attention to different information.

old: Before tuning a distinctive rule, name what it changes: the opponent’s state,
a location or an available action. Clear rules give numerical tuning a
purpose.
new: Before tuning a distinctive rule, name what it changes:
the opponent’s state, a location or an available action.
Clear rules give numerical tuning a purpose.

old: Forsburn’s footage shows two similar figures, followed by smoke obscuring the
fighters. It changes where an opponent must look to make a decision.
new: Forsburn’s footage shows two similar figures, followed by smoke obscuring
the fighters. It changes where an opponent must look to make a decision.

old: A damage table alone cannot describe this difference. Ask not only how strong
an attack is, but also what judgment it demands from the opponent.
new: A damage table alone cannot describe this difference. Ask not only how
strong an attack is, but also what judgment it demands from the opponent.

old: Smoke does not by itself prove invulnerability. Design and verify the
appearance, actual interaction rules and available responses separately.
new: Smoke does not by itself prove invulnerability. Design and verify the
appearance, actual interaction rules and available responses separately.

old: The fighters travel across the ground, through the air and beyond the platform
edge. Distance and position change the opportunities to use an ability.
new: The fighters travel across the ground, through the air and beyond the platform
edge. Distance and position change the opportunities to use an ability.

old: A strength needs more than a large number in a table. Connect it to an
advantageous choice and to the means of reaching that situation.
new: A strength needs more than a large number in a table. Connect it to
an advantageous choice and to the means of reaching that situation.

old: For a hypothetical close-pressure role, approach tools and choices after an
attack belong together. Raising damage without any way to get close can leave
that strength unusable.
new: For a hypothetical close-pressure role, approach tools and
choices after an attack belong together. Raising damage
without any way to get close can leave that strength unusable.

old: Once a strength exists, consider its limitations. Reducing every ability until
nothing works is different from giving a character a distinctive weakness.
new: Once a strength exists, consider its limitations. Reducing every ability until
nothing works is different from giving a character a distinctive weakness.

old: In a game with constantly changing positions, check whether a character can
leave an unfavorable distance or return to a range where their tools are
useful.
new: In a game with constantly changing positions, check
whether a character can leave an unfavorable distance
or return to a range where their tools are useful.

old: Keep responses available to the opponent too. Readable preparation and
openings after failure connect strengths and limitations into a coherent
playstyle.
new: Keep responses available to the opponent too.
Readable preparation and openings after failure connect
strengths and limitations into a coherent playstyle.

old: Distinguish a playable character’s role from an enemy’s role too. In a
hypothetical design, even a simple charging enemy can demand a different
response in a narrow corridor or in combination with another enemy. Verify the
placement’s effect through actual playtests.
new: Distinguish a playable character’s role from an enemy’s role too.
In a hypothetical design, even a simple charging enemy can demand
a different response in a narrow corridor or in combination with
another enemy. Verify the placement’s effect through actual playtests.

old: The percentages at the bottom are not an attack-power table. They show current
damage state, while remaining stocks are displayed separately.
new: The percentages at the bottom are not an attack-power table. They show
current damage state, while remaining stocks are displayed separately.

old: Separate base capabilities, active effects and player decisions when comparing
characters. A high percentage in one moment cannot establish which character
is stronger.
new: Separate base capabilities, active effects and player
decisions when comparing characters. A high percentage in
one moment cannot establish which character is stronger.

old: This is historical match footage. We use it to observe actions and states, not
to derive current character rankings or universal damage multipliers.
new: This is historical match footage. We use it to observe actions and states,
not to derive current character rankings or universal damage multipliers.

old: Dice and abilities change combat values in Dungeons of Aether. Hamir’s REACT
sequence shows a defense change followed by a blocked enemy attack.
new: Dice and abilities change combat values in Dungeons of Aether. Hamir’s
REACT sequence shows a defense change followed by a blocked enemy attack.

old: Slade’s STEAL increases coins after connecting, while Artemis’s STUN affects
the opponent’s dice state. These are separate shots, not one continuous
battle.
new: Slade’s STEAL increases coins after connecting, while
Artemis’s STUN affects the opponent’s dice state.
These are separate shots, not one continuous battle.

old: An ability’s identity is not limited to damage. Defense, resources and the
opponent’s options can also define a role. The displayed dice values are used
in the current turn; they are not the character’s fixed base capabilities.
new: An ability’s identity is not limited to damage. Defense, resources and the
opponent’s options can also define a role. The displayed dice values are used
in the current turn; they are not the character’s fixed base capabilities.

old: Fleet’s SNIPE description says that connecting deals damage and grants two
stamina dice on the next turn. It does not mean six stamina is added
immediately to the current value.
new: Fleet’s SNIPE description says that connecting deals damage
and grants two stamina dice on the next turn. It does not
mean six stamina is added immediately to the current value.

old: STRIKE in a separate boss shot shows a heart decreasing with the hit.
Similar-looking attack effects still need separate descriptions of what
changes and when.
new: STRIKE in a separate boss shot shows a heart decreasing
with the hit. Similar-looking attack effects still
need separate descriptions of what changes and when.

old: Write the trigger, affected target and application time together. This helps
the program’s actual behavior and the on-screen explanation describe the same
rule.
new: Write the trigger, affected target and application
time together. This helps the program’s actual behavior
and the on-screen explanation describe the same rule.

old: Differences alone do not make every combination fair. Making every capability
average does not automatically preserve interesting distinctions either.
new: Differences alone do not make every combination fair. Making every capability
average does not automatically preserve interesting distinctions either.

old: Check for opponents or locations with no workable response, and for tools that
solve every situation without preparation. Review conditions across repeated
tests rather than declaring balance from one match.
new: Check for opponents or locations with no workable response, and for
tools that solve every situation without preparation. Review conditions
across repeated tests rather than declaring balance from one match.

old: Repair problematic conditions and values while preserving what the character
does well. After a change, check whether the role still fits the same concise
description.
new: Repair problematic conditions and values while preserving
what the character does well. After a change, check
whether the role still fits the same concise description.

old: More unique rules create more combinations to verify: an effect ending, a turn
changing and an interaction with another ability.
new: More unique rules create more combinations to verify: an effect
ending, a turn changing and an interaction with another ability.

old: When adding distinct phenomena such as fire, water or smoke, begin with a
concise core rule rather than an endless list of exceptions. Explicit states
and transitions make test questions more concrete.
new: When adding distinct phenomena such as fire, water or smoke, begin
with a concise core rule rather than an endless list of exceptions.
Explicit states and transitions make test questions more concrete.

old: In what situation does this character gain an advantage, through what tool,
and how can an opponent respond? A shared answer keeps abilities and numerical
tuning moving in the same direction.
new: In what situation does this character gain an advantage, through
what tool, and how can an opponent respond? A shared answer keeps
abilities and numerical tuning moving in the same direction.

old: A character’s identity becomes clear when numerical differences create
different player choices. Build strengths, limitations and distinctive rules
on a shared baseline.
new: A character’s identity becomes clear when numerical
differences create different player choices. Build strengths,
limitations and distinctive rules on a shared baseline.

old: Separate base capabilities from current state, and specify the conditions and
timing of effects. Repair unusable weaknesses or universally dominant
strengths while keeping the role intact.
new: Separate base capabilities from current state, and specify the
conditions and timing of effects. Repair unusable weaknesses or
universally dominant strengths while keeping the role intact.

old: Before filling out the next character’s stat table, write one sentence about
the situation and choice you want players to remember.
new: Before filling out the next character’s stat table, write one
sentence about the situation and choice you want players to remember.
